name: Personal AI + AGI Base Architecture
current_known_point: KAGGLE-088+ in latest uploaded Kaggle notebook; historical roadmap continues through portability/recovery and later agent capabilities.
principles: Preserve verified foundation; never silently rebuild/retrain it.
Prefer deterministic tests over self-declared PASS.
Use the local model as planner/diagnostician, not as the final authority.
Every generated change must be syntax-checked, executed, tested, verified, and checkpointed.
Stop for human approval on destructive, security-sensitive, irreversible, paid, external-account, or ambiguous actions.
Keep personal and SaaS/business data logically isolated.
Keep model weights external to the source package when practical.
Treat Kaggle/Colab as temporary compute workers, not permanent state.
